CustomField.description: Shortfall/Surplus Amount of Drawdown from Settlements Domain
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
This is the customer total loan minus the payout amount minus any associated fees.
If final figure is positive it means there is a surplus for settlement. These funds are then credited to the customers nominated account at drawdown.
If the final figure is negative it means there is a shortfall for settlement. These funds are then debited from the customers nominated account to complete settlement.
CustomField.label: Shortfall/Surplus Amount
